description: Discover Valuable Insights, Analyze Segmentation, and Visualize Progressive Steps with Funnel Chart by Powerviz. The Powerviz Funnel chart is a powerful visual that helps businesses monitor and analyze data progression through different process stages. It is particularly useful for understanding sales pipelines, marketing campaigns, and website visitor flow. The Powerviz funnel chart offers a range of features like different display styles, orientations, smart labels, conditional formatting, split stages into sub-section, ranking, fill pattern, conversion rate, and a wide range of colors. Check out the live demo here. To access all advanced settings features, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Funnel Settings – Multiple Display Types and Orientation to pick from. Data Colors – Offers 30+ color palettes including color-blind safe mode for better accessibility. Labels – Customize data labels to enhance user experience. Display a combination of categories, values, and percentages of the total. Fill Patterns – Choose from an array of Fill Pattern options, or bring your own patterns. Ranking - Filter out Top/Bottom N stages. Conversion Rate – Understand the efficiency of the process easily by adding the conversion rate to the funnel chart. Totals – Display the total value at the top or bottom of the funnel…
